Name: Multi-Room Sheds
Author: neuralwiles
Description:
Changes the Shed and Big Shed to have multiple rooms!

[size=4][i]Features[/i][/size]
  ♡  Larger Shed and Big Shed maps with multiple rooms for easy organization.
  ♡  Sheds are fully decoratable with multiple floor and wall areas.
  ♡  Optional toggle to allow casking in sheds (disabled by default).
  ♡  Recolor compatible.


If you enjoy this mod, check out my other map mods!
